response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls adorned with the royal crest. But something is amiss. The once-majestic halls are now filled with the eerie glow of old CRT TVs, their screens flickering with distorted images of 80s VHS tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear neon-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... (he consults a dusty old book)...Vaporwave.

ADVISOR 1
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. The aesthetics of the future. The nostalgia of the past. The... (he searches for the right words)...the "wet" of the digital age.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now a sprawling landscape of retro-futuristic architecture, complete with neon-lit water towers and giant, distorted video screens. The sound of distant synthesizers and distorted VHS tapes fills the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III stands before a massive, distorted VHS tape, its image flickering with static.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is the future, my friends. A future where the boundaries between reality and fantasy are blurred. Where the past and present collide in a swirl of... (he searches for the right words)...glitchy, distorted beauty.

ADVISOR 2
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, isn't this just... (he glances around the room)...a bit... weird?

REGINALD
(laughing)
Weird? Ha! This is the future, my friend. And in the future, weird is beautiful.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The kingdom's subjects, dressed in their finest neon-colored attire, gather around the castle walls, watching in awe as the king's vision takes shape. The air is filled with the sweet scent of burning incense and the distant hum of synthesizers.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom's aesthetic has transformed into a surreal, proto-vaporwave landscape. The once-majestic castle now stands as a monument to the power of imagination and the blurring of boundaries between reality and fantasy.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is just the beginning, my friends. The future is now. And the future is... (he smiles)...glitchy.

FADE TO BLACK.
